_comments_expected.runs: TWO RUNS, NOT FOUR, AND THE GAP IS THE POINT. This project has FOUR standing reds - verify_md's 'file length', verify_code's three rows, stepb_audit's check 10, and claudemd_disposal's 37-carried-nowhere. ONLY TWO CAN BE DECLARED HERE, because verify_expected reads ROWS and not prose, so a command must carry --report-json, and stepb_audit.py and claudemd_disposal.py are this project's OWN tools and have no such flag. Recorded as a declared limit rather than left as an unexplained absence: a reader comparing 'four standing reds' against two runs here would otherwise conclude something had been forgotten. TRIGGER THAT CLOSES IT: --report-json added to either project tool, at which point its red belongs here too. WHAT THIS BUYS THAT PROSE DID NOT: the second arm, 'every declaration still fails'. A toleration that stops being needed is reported as DECL-STALE, so an exemption cannot quietly outlive the defect it was written for - which is exactly what happened to the 350-line cap, retired and still sitting in this file for days.
